metadata.title: Wolpert (1969) French Flag Positional Information, Tickle-Wolpert (1975) Chick Limb ZPA Digit Specification & Ben-Zvi-Barkai (2010) Expansion-Repression Scaling Reference Dataset

sources.citation: Wolpert L (1969). Positional information and the spatial pattern of cellular differentiation. Journal of Theoretical Biology 25(1):1-47.
Crick F (1970). Diffusion in embryogenesis. Nature 225(5231):420-422.
Tickle C, Summerbell D, Wolpert L (1975). Positional signalling and specification of digits in chick limb morphogenesis. Nature 254(5497):199-202.
Riddle RD, Johnson RL, Laufer E, Tabin C (1993). Sonic hedgehog mediates the polarizing activity of the ZPA. Cell 75(7):1401-1416.
Ben-Zvi D, Barkai N (2010). Scaling of morphogen gradients by an expansion-repression integral feedback control. PNAS 107(15):6924-6929.

gallus_gallus_embryo_72h.species: Gallus gallus domesticus (72h HH18-20 embryo in ovo with radial area vasculosa and budding limb primordia)

wolpert_1969_french_flag_model.section: Wolpert (1969) J. Theor. Biol. 25:1-47, Sections 2-4 & Figs. 1-4

sdd_exponential_decay.equation: dc/dt = D * d^2c/dx^2 - k * c  =>  c_SDD(x) = c0 * exp(-x / lambda), lambda = sqrt(D / k)
sdd_exponential_decay.note: Thresholds T1 = exp(-100/lambda) and T2 = exp(-200/lambda) give exact 1/3 : 1/3 : 1/3 French Flag proportions at reference length L0 = 300 um, but fail to scale when L changes unless lambda scales with L.

expansion_repression_scaling.equation: dc/dt = D(E) * d^2c/dx^2 - k(E) * c;  dE/dt = D_E * d^2E/dx^2 + alpha_E * H(T_rep - c(L,t)) - beta_E * E

tickle_wolpert_1975_chick_limb_zpa.section: Tickle, Summerbell & Wolpert (1975) Nature 254:199-202 & Riddle et al. (1993) Cell 75:1401-1416
tickle_wolpert_1975_chick_limb_zpa.organism: Gallus gallus wing bud (HH20-HH28 anteroposterior axis, ~500 um -> 1000 um)
tickle_wolpert_1975_chick_limb_zpa.morphogen: Sonic hedgehog (Shh) secreted by posterior Zone of Polarizing Activity (ZPA)

experimental_regimes.description: Normal chick wing bud with single posterior ZPA at x = 0
Tickle et al. (1975) classic ZPA graft to anterior margin (x = L) producing mirror-image duplication
Irradiated / fewer-cell ZPA graft at anterior margin (c_ant = 0.35 * c0) specifying up to digit 3 anteriorly
Negative control: ZPA excision / Shh signaling blockade (c(x) < T_digit2 everywhere)
